sottotitolo: Enrolments, family replies, fees and forms for the year that is opening, at a glance. These are numbers: names are in the lists that open from here.
nessunAnno: Choose the year with enrolments open using the year selector to see where we stand.
annoNonAperto: Enrolments for this year are not open: the dashboard appears when they are. They open from Settings, under “School year”, with “Open enrolments”.
annoAttivo: This is the current year. Choose the year with enrolments open using the year selector.
nonDisponibile: Not available: this location’s database does not have the update the dashboard needs yet.
erroreRete: I can’t connect. Check the connection and try again.
errorePermesso: You don’t have permission to see the dashboard.
erroreGenerico: The dashboard could not be read. Try again shortly.
postiRiga: {iscritti, plural, one {# enrolled} other {# enrolled}} out of {posti, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}
postiSenzaLimite: {iscritti, plural, one {# enrolled} other {# enrolled}}, places not set
postiOltre: Over the places: a warning, not a block.
postiVuoto: No enrolments in the year yet.
risposteIntro: Out of {n, plural, one {# child} other {# children}} in the current year.
nuoveRiga: {n, plural, one {# child coming from outside or returning} other {# children coming from outside or returning}}
quotaSenzaListino: of which without a price list: the fee cannot be generated
quotaStima: Estimate from the price list for those without a fee yet: {importo}. It is an estimate and is not added to what was collected.
quotaRitirati: {n, plural, one {# withdrawn enrolment still has a payment item the family can see} other {# withdrawn enrolments still have a payment item the family can see}} (collected: {importo}).
incrocioIntro: Out of {n, plural, one {# enrolment} other {# enrolments}} in the new year.
incrocioModuliSenzaQuota: Forms handed in, fee to pay
incrocioPiuVoci: {n, plural, one {# enrolment without a fee has several items to check in accounting} other {# enrolments without a fee have several items to check in accounting}}.
moduliVuoto: No forms are required for this year.
moduloMancanti: {n, plural, =0 {none missing} one {missing for # child} other {missing for # children}}
firmaMostra: Who has not signed in the app
firmaTitolo: Have not signed in the app: {modulo}
firmaVuoto: Everyone has signed in the app.
firmaTotale: {n, plural, one {# child has not signed} other {# children have not signed}} in the app.
firmaErrore: The list could not be read. Try again shortly.
confrontoIntro: The same day a year ago ({giorno}).
confrontoRiga: {anno}: {domande, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}}, {conferme, plural, one {# confirmation} other {# confirmations}}
confrontoNota: This year withdrawn confirmations are not counted, as in “Confirmed”.
confrontoRicostruito: Last year’s confirmations had no real date: they are rebuilt from the children’s creation dates, and applications are only counted since the online form exists (there is no data before that). Last year’s numbers are approximate.
confrontoVuoto: There is no earlier year to compare with.
